title: 1871: the Sherman House and Chamber of Commerce match their photographs
items: The Sherman House's iron galleries are now open railings, with its third-floor balcony on Randolph Street, a heavier Clark Street portico and the stone balustrade round its rooftop belvedere.
The Chamber of Commerce gains the stone balcony over its three-arched entrance and the large curved pediments over its upper windows.
The balconies of the Tremont House, Crosby's Opera House and the Palmer House are open iron railings too.
